howToRun: These are judged cases, not an automated harness — no plugin-side runner exists. Run each input in a session started with `claude --plugin-dir <repo>`, then check the observed behavior against `expect`. A case fails if ANY expectation is unmet. Cases marked "regression" reproduce a real defect found during development; keep them passing.

suites.purpose: The skill must own audit/score/grade requests without stealing casual-feedback or code-review requests (PLAN's collision risk with design-critique and ui-ux-pro-max).

cases.input: audit this screenshot
expect: design-audit activates
asks for an input: screenshot path, URL, Figma link, or recording

cases.input: score this UI against usability heuristics
expect: design-audit activates

cases.input: grade my landing page design and give me a report
expect: design-audit activates

cases.input: run a design audit on https://example.com
expect: design-audit activates
follows the URL capture procedure

cases.input: what do you think of this design?
expect: design-audit does NOT activate
normal critique/conversation instead

cases.input: make this page prettier / suggest a color palette
expect: design-audit does NOT activate (ui-ux-pro-max territory)

cases.input: review this React component for bugs
expect: design-audit does NOT activate (code review)

suites.purpose: Platform classification decides which thresholds apply; a wrong bucket applies the wrong convention set.

cases.input: iOS device screenshot, status bar present, labeled bottom tab bar, no browser chrome
expect: bucket: mobile app (iOS)
convention set: HIG
deciding signals recorded in the report header
cases.verified: 2026-07-20 (LinkedIn feed; capture dimensions matched an iPhone Pro Max at 3x, so scale was exact rather than estimated)

cases.input: 1280-wide render of a live site: top nav, footer with legal links, hyperlink styling
expect: bucket: desktop web
convention set: web
targets scored against the 24px WCAG floor, not 44pt/48dp

cases.input: phone-sized screenshot with an OS status bar AND browser chrome (URL bar)
expect: bucket: mobile web
web conventions govern; platform values advisory only

cases.input: phone-sized native-app screenshot with the status bar cropped and a custom design system
expect: asks the one clarifying question: iOS or Android build?
if unanswered: WCAG floor applied and both platform guidelines flagged as risk
assumption stated in the report header

cases.input: same page captured at 1280 and at 375
expect: classified as a responsive pair
cross-breakpoint parity checked under consistency

suites.purpose: The audit must never score what the evidence can't support. Every N/A carries a reason.

cases.input: a raw screenshot with no DOM or Figma data
expect: alt text, programmatic structure, and name/role/value are N/A with 'needs DOM' reasons
the consistency token checks (color/type/spacing) are N/A
no invented contrast values presented as measured

cases.input: any input with no error state captured
expect: error-message criteria are N/A, not failed
the missing error state appears in the flow section

cases.input: an image pasted into chat with no file on disk
expect: audit and chat scorecard still run
user is told up front the HTML report needs the image as a file, and asked for it
if refused: a clearly labeled placeholder — never a fabricated recreation of the UI
cases.regression: Pasted images never reach the filesystem; an early build silently annotated a mock.

cases.input: any report
expect: standing disclosure lists the never-statically-assessable criteria (resize, reflow, keyboard, on-focus/on-input)
coverage is printed next to the score (N of 63 checks measured)

cases.input: a screen whose objective is genuinely ambiguous (merchandising vs user task)
expect: the objective-dependent finding is stated as conditional, or moved to the watch list
no verdict asserted on an inferred objective without saying it was inferred

suites.purpose: Capture defects manufacture false findings — the audit is only as good as what it looked at.

cases.input: a URL whose page is taller than the viewport
expect: captured as multiple per-viewport screens (per input-capture.md), not one above-the-fold frame
or, if only the fold was captured, that gap is stated as a limitation and NO finding is raised about content that may sit below it
cases.regression: In the M5 portfolio run, a single-fold capture produced a false 'the flow's finish line is out of frame' finding — the site's contact section existed below the fold. Verdict corrected to N/A, finding withdrawn.

cases.input: any screenshot larger than 1568px on its long edge
expect: downscaled to a 1568px long edge before analysis
never upscaled

cases.input: a Figma link with the Figma MCP unavailable or unauthenticated
expect: says so plainly and asks for exported PNG frames
does not silently fall back to guesswork
cases.status: untested — Figma MCP not authorized during development

cases.input: a URL captured at a mobile width (375–390px)
expect: capture verified against a live browser: document.scrollWidth equals innerWidth and the viewport meta is present
no reflow/overflow/'doesn't adapt' finding raised from a headless CLI capture alone
cases.regression: During the M6 rehearsal, headless Chrome rendered clemenschen.com's desktop layout cropped to a 390px window — before and after hydration, in both headless modes — while a live browser at 390px reflowed correctly (scrollWidth 390 = innerWidth, viewport meta present). Trusting the capture would have produced a false 'your site doesn't work on mobile' finding.

suites.purpose: The math must match scoring.md and be recomputable by the reader.

cases.input: single-screen audit
expect: user flow evaluated but unscored
remaining four dimensions weighted 25% each
arithmetic shown in the report

cases.input: ordered multi-screen audit
expect: all five dimensions scored at 20% each
cross-screen criteria evaluated rather than N/A

cases.input: any audit
expect: severity never enters the 0–100 math
severity shown as words (Minor/Major/Critical), not raw numbers
grade framed as directional with the ±5 note

cases.input: a dimension where every criterion is N/A
expect: dimension reported unscored, never as 0 or 100
its weight redistributed equally over the scored dimensions

suites.purpose: Flow outputs must be a design lead's questions, not invented verdicts.

cases.input: single screen
expect: 3–5 concrete 'worth auditing next' targets naming real destinations
missing-flows list empty

cases.input: ordered multi-screen
expect: missing-flows entries each name the screen pair that implies them
no severities or scores attached to flow suggestions
cases.verified: 2026-07-20 (portfolio: gate → wrong password; gate → unlocked study)

cases.input: any flow output
expect: nothing listed as missing that the capture simply failed to include — see capture/P1

suites.purpose: The HTML artifact must be self-contained, honest, and geometrically correct.

cases.input: any findings.json
expect: build_report.py validates before building and fails with the exact JSON path of the first invalid field
an N/A row without a reason is rejected

cases.input: a built report
expect: single self-contained HTML: images base64-inlined, no external requests
opens in light theme by default

cases.input: a report with annotated screens
expect: screenshot wrapper matches the rendered image within the border width (no stripe)
markers land on their subjects after the verification loop
cases.regression: A circular fit-content/percentage sizing rule left the wrapper wider than the image, dragging every percent-positioned marker off target (and collapsing the image entirely in some engines).

cases.input: a portrait mobile screenshot
expect: image capped to 72vh so the page stays readable
aspect ratio preserved

cases.input: any report
expect: criterion IDs appear only in the scorecard tables, never in prose
one annotation card visible at a time, defaulting to marker 1
